hero.headline: Build systems that outlast the projects.
hero.subdescription: We hire slowly and keep teams small. If you have been frustrated by design that stops at handoff, you will recognize how we work.

whyUs.subdescription: Four things that are true here and are not true at most studios.

perks.title: You own the outcome
perks.body: Not a ticket queue. You take a problem from first conversation to what ships, and stay through build.

perks.title: Remote, with overlap
perks.body: Work where you want. Four hours of daily overlap so decisions happen in conversation, not threads.

perks.title: Time to go deep
perks.body: Two focus days a week with no meetings. Systems work does not happen in thirty-minute gaps.

perks.title: Learning budget
perks.body: A yearly budget for courses, conferences and tools — with time set aside to actually use it.
